instructions.allocation: User-selected allocation: 50% S&P 500 price index (SPX), 50% IEF 7-10 Year US Treasury ETF. Weights are fractions of portfolio value in EUR.
instructions.weights: Use decimal fractions (0.20 means 20%) of market value in reporting currency. Complete holding weights must match target_allocation and sum to 1. No automatic normalization. This first schema is long-only.
instructions.nav: Optional portfolio market value in EUR. Required later, together with prices, FX and multipliers, to turn weights into quantities. No quantities are calculated now.
instructions.options: Options are contract reference data only, not portfolio holdings. Contract-code discovery does not download prices or calibrate a volatility surface.
instructions.fx: EURUSD is quoted in USD per EUR: EUR value = USD value / EURUSD. Reporting currency does not change native quote currencies.
instructions.scope: SPX is a model index exposure, not a directly purchasable security. This configuration does not place orders or calculate quantities. The only other holding is IEF.
